//: The server compiles to dist/ because Electron require()s it and Node cannot
load TypeScript. rootDir is '.' so index.ts and seed.ts are included
alongside src/ — the emitted tree is dist/index.js and dist/src/**.
prisma/ deliberately stays at server/prisma and is NOT copied into dist.
src/config/paths.ts finds it by walking up to the directory containing
prisma/schema.prisma, so the same code resolves correctly whether it runs
strict and allowJs:false are enabled here rather than in tsconfig.base.json:
desktop/ has not been converted yet, so flipping either in the shared base
would break that package. A per-package override is how each flag advances
one package at a time — it cannot be scoped to a folder within a package.
allowJs:false is safe because tests/ is now TypeScript too (see
server/jest.config.js) and no other .js file is matched by 'include'.
tests/ is included here (rather than excluded) so `tsc --noEmit` covers
the test suite under the same strict settings as src/ — ts-jest itself
so this include is what actually gates strictness on tests; it doesn't
affect how ts-jest transforms files at test-run time.
